acceptanceCriteria: External benchmark subsets are pinned by digest and run offline; results are recorded in BUILD-LOG with the exact subset and metric definitions.
The already-fixed control produces abstention, and any confident answer on it is a recorded failure.
Results are evidence for later promotions, not a promotion by themselves.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: evaluation runs only on Corvint's own frozen benchmark. Add a bounded, local adapter to ContextBench (arXiv 2602.05892) and Agent Retrieval Bench metrics, and add an already-fixed control to the confidently-wrong trial so the packet must abstain when the task is already resolved at the pinned revision (arXiv 2603.25764). Owning spec: docs/specs/context-evolution-program-v0.md.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #96 (decision 0372, CEP-V0-001..006), integrated via PR #100: ContextBench adapter with digest-pinned offline subsets and cb_file/cb_line coverage and precision metrics recorded in BUILD-LOG with the exact subset and metric definitions (AC1); already-fixed abstention control run offline with script agents: the base corvint packet answered READY (`no-specific-terms`) so the corvint arm records control_failed=1, a recorded failure (AC2; follow-up ticket filed); results are recorded as evidence, not a promotion (AC3). Two sealed CEMs: the feature range and the review-fix range (REQUIREMENTS.tsv regeneration). NOT_RUN: full ContextBench (no bundled repositories; 66 clones exceed the 2 GB offline bound), model arm of the control. NOT_OBSERVED: held-out control set. NOT_RUN: `make gate` locally (owner policy; PR #100 CI is the repository-wide gate).

title: eval: score packets on external retrieval benchmarks and add an already-fixed abstention control
